caseName: Madura v. Bank of Am., N.A.
caseNameFull: Andrzej MADURA, et ux. v. BANK OF AMERICA, N.A.

opinions.text: Motion of petitioner for leave to proceed in forma pauperis denied, and the petition for a writ of certiorari to the United States Court of Appeals for the Eleventh Circuit dismissed. See Rule 39.8.
